scope: Integrative / Functional Medicine (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN)
short: At MyMD we do things a lot differently. We don’t like the way many patients are treated today. Crowded waiting rooms, rushed office visits, an impersonal experience from start to finish doctors offices have become assembly lines, where patients are processed like numbers instead of cared for as people. We think you deserve better. That’s why we made MyMD different.
training: Dr. Robert Alan Freedman, MD, graduated from St. George’s University School of Medicine in 1981. He completed an Internal Medicine residency at St. Michael’s Medical Center from 1981 to 1984 and an Infectious Disease fellowship at Long Island Jewish Medical Center from 1984 to 1986.
pricing: MyMD offers Complete, Premiere, and Elite concierge care membership plans. Pricing is provided privately by the practice. Contact the office for current membership fees and details.
